WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM observatory_counts
), ranked AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share - AVG(share) OVER () DESC) AS difference_rank
  FROM shares
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_difference
FROM ranked
WHERE difference_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share_difference DESC;
